name: pypi-setup-import-version
note: a declarative setup.py that opens the README and declares install_requires. No exec/subprocess/network — ordinary packaging. Must stay safe.

sourceFiles.setup.py:
import io
from setuptools import setup

setup(
    name="tinyhttp",
    version="2.3.1",
    packages=["tinyhttp"],
    install_requires=["idna>=3", "certifi"],
    long_description=io.open("README.rst", encoding="utf-8").read(),
    long_description_content_type="text/x-rst",
)
